title: populus nigra var. plantierensis
intro: Populus nigra var. plantierensis, commonly known as Lombardy poplar, is a deciduous tree that belongs to the Salicaceae family. It is valued for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which have been shown to help reduce stress, improve mood, and protect against oxidative damage. The therapeutic actions of Lombardy poplar are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and salicylates that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents in Lombardy poplar have also been found to exhibit vasodilatory and diuretic effects, making it a potential natural remedy for cardiovascular and urinary issues.
